params.name: edgeId
params.description: A string value representing the edge id. For example, '784f394c-42b6-435a-983c-b7beff2784f9'

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Maximum amount of entities in a one page

params.name: page
params.description: Sequence number of page starting from 0

params.name: textSearch
params.description: The case insensitive 'substring' filter based on the edge event type name.

params.name: sortProperty
params.description: Property of entity to sort by

params.name: startTime
params.description: Timestamp. Edge events with creation time before it won't be queried

params.name: endTime
params.description: Timestamp. Edge events with creation time after it won't be queried

items.docs: Returns a page of edge events for the requested edge. You can specify parameters to filter the results. The result is wrapped with PageData object that allows you to iterate over result set using pagination. See response schema for more details.
